description.value: Hyatt Grand Central New York is a hotel located at 109 East 42nd Street in Midtown Manhattan. The building stands adjoining Grand Central Terminal, so trains and subways are steps away. It suits a trip that mixes Midtown sightseeing with day trips by rail. Trip.com shows 7.9 / 10 Good 207 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “right next to Grand Central Station, making it super convenient for getting around”. Representative watch-outs: “the staff were very impatient when answering the phone”.
